Pin is ~375 m north of the loop in woods; re-pin proposed. Not waterfront confirmed. Season stays unsourced.
flags: PIN: 44.6035,-92.0327 -> 44.6004,-92.0308 (about 375 m; imagery estimate). The stored point (also Google's) is in unbroken forest north of the campground.
